title: Tomato Leaf Disease Classification Dataset
credit: Nure Alam Siddiki Rachin, Nasim Mahmud Likhon, and Md Abdullah Hel Baki
roles: Independent source for test only. No image or score from this source may influence training, model selection, or threshold development.
sampling: Up to 125 JPGs per compatible publisher folder, rank by SHA-256 of the release name and publisher file ID. Retain all 112 late blight candidates. Screen before model predictions.
notes: Reference labels are inherited. The publisher reports capture across agricultural regions of Bangladesh, March 10–20, 2025. Published folder metadata does not establish individual specimen IDs.
